requirements.last_valid_training_state: DaggerBFSSession validates student output without mutating Search Memory, stores the full last-valid memory and observable input, and queries the expert from the unchanged pending request
requirements.raw_student_provenance: correction records preserve raw student text, strict parse result, trusted runtime result, invalid-operation charge, model input and view binding
requirements.rejected_student_not_applied: pure BFS validation precedes mutation; invalid student operations never enter trusted rollout events; a separately recorded accepted expert operation may continue the rollout
requirements.expert_query_accounting: each correction records expert_query_charge=1, invalid_operation_charge=1 and the accepted expert target/runtime result
requirements.rollout_correction_links: correction IDs, global collection decision indices, last-valid accepted-event counts and applied rollout-event indices bind each correction to its episode
requirements.independent_replay: replay_dagger_episode reconstructs every input, validation, correction, applied event and final Search Memory without model calls; tampered hidden teacher input is rejected
requirements.split_isolation: the interface accepts only split=train and the frozen 25-task order is derived exactly from the original BFS training membership; development/final tasks are rejected
requirements.certification: certify_corrections rejects provenance, task, checkpoint, modality, iteration, serializer, expert-input, output-budget and conflicting-identical-input drift
requirements.bfs_three_modalities: dagger-protocol.json fixes BFS with text-state, visual-state and multimodal-state
requirements.two_sequential_iterations: execution order requires iteration-1 collection/replay and update before iteration-2 collection from the DAgger iteration-1 checkpoint
requirements.bounded_collection: each modality/iteration has at most 512 student decisions and 128 expert corrections, with per-task model calls fixed at twice matching exact-reference decisions
requirements.unused_quota: quota expires within its modality/iteration; correction exhaustion retains the next rejected student output without repair and stops; no transfer, duplication or invention is allowed
requirements.aggregation: all unique cumulative corrections replace the suffix of the fixed ordered original membership; repeated genuine inputs are retained as evidence but only the earliest trains; original records fill unused slots
requirements.matched_update_exposure: DAgger and continued-SFT both use exactly 512 records, one epoch, global batch 32, seed 17, sequential no-shuffle sampling and 16 optimizer updates per iteration
requirements.continued_sft_controls: continued-SFT uses the unchanged original 512 BFS records in both iterations and follows its own two-step checkpoint lineage from the same starting adapter
requirements.checkpoint_policy: one training seed 17 per cell, new optimizer/scheduler per iteration, adapter weights only for continuation, final checkpoint only for evaluation and no training-seed variance claim
requirements.estimand: the protocol states a within-modality DAgger-versus-continued-SFT effect; separately on-policy modality trajectories are not treated as paired modality evidence
requirements.hardware_qualification: both A100 workers loaded all three BFS adapters, ran prompt-only full-output scalar and repeated-batch inference, and completed finite discarded trainable-adapter optimizer steps without changing checkpoints
requirements.scheduler_and_ports: shared scheduler attempts dagger-qualification-0/1 and final audit succeeded with passing hooks; exact MASTER_PORT mapping is GPU0=18800 and GPU1=18801
requirements.cost_admission: dagger-qualification.json records 0.14161082983016968 GPU-hours spent, 234.941909 full-allowance GPU-hours as infeasible, and 35.458081 conditional historical-consumption GPU-hours within the fixed 48-hour cap
requirements.no_outcome_selected_scope: all declared tasks/panels remain; coverage_reduction is null and model outcomes were not used for coverage selection
requirements.no_scientific_execution: qualification records zero collection decisions, corrections and persistent training updates; Goals 5 and 6 retain ownership of collection and scientific training
requirements.tests: 33 affected visual, multimodal, expanded-baseline and DAgger tests passed; the six focused DAgger tests include hidden-teacher, replay, split, serializer, budget, conflict, quota and aggregation checks
